title: Is the U.S. Ready to Vote by Mail?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域举足轻重的领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》App 进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bilbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·比尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《今日早报》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The United States is preparing to hold its first socially distant presidential election in history.
sentences.zh: 美国正准备举行历史上首次保持社交距离的总统选举。

sentences.en: Will it actually work?
sentences.zh: 这真的行得通吗？

sentences.en: My colleague, Reid Epstein, on what we've learned from the very different experience of two states.
sentences.zh: 我的同事里德·爱泼斯坦将为我们讲述，我们从两个截然不同的州的经验中学到了什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月4日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Reid, it is precisely three months to the day until Election Day.
sentences.zh: 里德，那么距离选举日正好还有整整三个月。

sentences.en: And from what you can tell, given the state of the pandemic, will voting on November 3rd at all resemble the way we have cast ballots in the past?
sentences.zh: 根据你所了解的情况以及目前的疫情形势，11月3日的投票还会有一点像我们过去的投票方式吗？

sentences.en: For a lot of us, no.
sentences.zh: 对我们很多人来说，不会了。

sentences.en: You know, the sort of idea that people have that they wake up the morning of
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们过去那种认为自己会在

sentences.en: Election Day and go to the middle school or a church or something nearby and wait in line for a few minutes and vote.
sentences.zh: 选举日早晨醒来，然后去附近的初中、教堂或者某个地方，排队几分钟并进行投票的想法。

sentences.en: For a lot of us, that's going to be replaced with opening your mailbox and seeing a
sentences.zh: 对我们很多人来说，那将被打开邮箱，看到

sentences.en: ballot that comes from your local board of elections and sitting down at the kitchen table and figuring
sentences.zh: 当地选举委员会寄来的选票，然后坐在餐桌旁弄清楚

sentences.en: out sort of who's running for what and looking for what they stand for and filling in the ovals as you see fit.
sentences.zh: 谁在竞选什么职位、了解他们的主张，并按照你的意愿在椭圆框里涂黑所取代。

sentences.en: And then when you're done with that, you'll either put it back in the mailbox or you'll drop it off in a ballot collection box.
sentences.zh: 当你做完这些后，要么把它放回邮箱，要么把它投进选票收集箱里。

sentences.en: And that will be how people vote.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们投票的方式。

sentences.en: And it will take place over a matter of weeks and not just crammed in on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 而且这将历时数周完成，而不是全部挤在选举日当天。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, what you're describing is mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 为了明确一下，你所描述的就是邮寄投票。

sentences.en: And I want to make sure I understand exactly what that is, because I think for a lot of people, there's a familiarity with absentee voting.
sentences.zh: 我想确保自己准确理解了这是什么，因为我觉得对很多人来说，大家对缺席投票都很熟悉。

sentences.en: And is that different?
sentences.zh: 这跟那个有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it's basically the same.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上是一样的。

sentences.en: A lot of us have received an absentee ballot if we're traveling for work or at school and not at home.
sentences.zh: 如果我们因为出差或上学而不在家，我们很多人都收到过缺席选票。

sentences.en: But mail-in voting is on a mass scale of absentee voting that we're going to see for this election.
sentences.zh: 但这次选举中我们要看到的邮寄投票，是规模化了的缺席投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what has been our experience in the United States with mail-in voting up to this point?
sentences.zh: 那么到目前为止，我们在美国的邮寄投票经验是怎样的？

sentences.en: It's very different depending on where you live.
sentences.zh: 根据你居住的地方，情况大不相同。

sentences.en: There are five states that have been conducting their elections entirely by mail.
sentences.zh: 有五个州完全通过邮寄方式进行选举。

sentences.en: Washington, Oregon, Hawaii, Utah, and Colorado, where they send ballots to every registered voter and people return them either through the mail or in drop boxes.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州、俄勒冈州、夏威夷州、犹他州和科罗拉多州，它们把选票寄给每一位登记选民，人们通过邮寄或投递箱将选票寄回。

sentences.en: And so if you live in one of those places, this year's election will look pretty normal to you.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你住在这些地方，今年的选举对你来说会显得很正常。

sentences.en: You'll get your ballot.
sentences.zh: 你会收到你的选票。

sentences.en: If you live in Washington state, you'll get a little booklet, which will be, you know, 80 to
sentences.zh: 如果你住在华盛顿州，你会收到一本小册子，大概有

sentences.en: 100 pages with testimonials from everyone who's running for every office on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 80到100页，里面包含了选票上竞选各个职位的每个候选人的自荐信。

sentences.en: Dog catcher to
sentences.zh: 从捉狗官到

sentences.en: President of the United States that you have a chance to read and study.
sentences.zh: 美国总统，你都有机会阅读和研究。

sentences.en: And you'll fill it out at your leisure.
sentences.zh: 你可以空闲时慢慢填写。

sentences.en: And as long as you have it returned by whatever the local deadline is, your vote will count.
sentences.zh: 只要你在当地规定的截止日期前寄回，你的选票就会有效。

sentences.en: And by all accounts, how well does mail-in voting work in those five states?
sentences.zh: 从各方面来看，邮寄投票在这五个州运行得怎么样？

sentences.en: It works great by almost all accounts from anybody you talk to in those states, from both parties.
sentences.zh: 从你在这些州交谈过的任何人（来自两党）的各方反馈来看，运行得非常好。

sentences.en: It has increased turnout, particularly among demographics of people who are least likely to vote otherwise.
sentences.zh: 它提高了投票率，尤其是那些原本最不可能投票的人群的投票率。

sentences.en: I had a conversation last week with the Republican state party chairman in Utah who said that Utahns have
sentences.zh: 我上周与犹他州共和党州党部主席交谈过，他说犹他州人

sentences.en: been voting by mail for over a decade and that they have effective safeguards and procedures in place to
sentences.zh: 进行邮寄投票已经有十多年了，他们有有效的保障措施和程序来

sentences.en: keep the voting on the up and up and that they don't expect any problems there with mail voting this fall
sentences.zh: 保证投票公正无误，并且他们预计今年秋天邮寄投票不会出现任何问题，

sentences.en: because they haven't had any in the paSt. So mail-in voting is smooth in the states that have it.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在过去没有遇到过任何问题。所以邮寄投票在实行它的各州非常顺利。

sentences.en: And of course, many other states have some level experience with absentee ballots, which would
sentences.zh: 当然，许多其他州对缺席选票也有一定程度的经验，这

sentences.en: seem to suggest there's a pretty straightforward path to taking mail-in voting nationwide for the entire country in 2020.
sentences.zh: 似乎表明，在2020年将邮寄投票推广到全美，有一条相当直接的途径。

sentences.en: You might think that, but it's been proven to not be that simple.
sentences.zh: 你可能会这么认为，但事实证明事情并没有那么简单。

sentences.en: And the best example of where things have gotten messy was in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 事情变得一团糟的最佳例子就是佐治亚州。

sentences.en: Georgia's presidential primary was supposed to be back in March.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州的总统初选原本应该在3月份举行。

sentences.en: And a couple weeks before it was held, the Secretary of State, a Republican named
sentences.zh: 就在举行前几周，州务卿（一位名叫

sentences.en: Brad Raffensperger, postponed it to May.
sentences.zh: 布拉德·拉芬斯珀格的共和党人）将其推迟到了5月。

sentences.en: And then a couple weeks before the May primary, everything was postponed to June because they didn't quite know what to do with the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 然后就在5月初选前几周，由于他们不太清楚该如何应对疫情，一切又都被推迟到了6月。

sentences.en: And after the second postponement, it was clear that they needed to do something to alleviate what they expected to be a crush of people voting on their primary day.
sentences.zh: 在第二次推迟之后，很明显他们需要采取措施来缓解他们预计会在初选日爆发的投票人潮。

sentences.en: And so they sent absentee ballot application forms to nearly 7 million active registered voters in Georgia in an effort to get people to vote by mail and not
sentences.zh: 因此，他们向佐治亚州近700万名活跃的已登记选民寄去了缺席选票申请表，目的是让人通过邮寄投票，而不是

sentences.en: come into either early voting centers or election day voting sites.
sentences.zh: 前往早期投票中心或选举日投票点。

sentences.en: So 7 million people got applications for ballots, but not ballots themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以有700万人收到了选票申请表，但不是选票本身。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So how many people ultimately sought a ballot with these applications in Georgia?
sentences.zh: 那么在佐治亚州，最终有多少人通过这些申请表索取了选票？

sentences.en: About a million and a half people returned the ballot applications from the state to their county boards of elections.
sentences.zh: 大约有150万人将州里的选票申请表交回了他们的县选举委员会。

sentences.en: And almost all of those people received a ballot, but there were still tens of thousands of people who requested ballots and didn't receive them.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有这些人都收到了选票，但仍然有数万名请求选票的人没有收到。

sentences.en: Either it didn't show up or it showed up after the election or it showed up a malfunctioning ballot or a bad return envelope or some way that it couldn't be returned properly.
sentences.zh: 要么是没寄到，要么是选举结束后才寄到，要么是寄来了有故障的选票、糟糕的返回信封，或者因为某种原因无法正确寄回。

sentences.en: One example of that is Stacey Abrams, who was the Democratic Party nominee for governor in 2018.
sentences.zh: 其中的一个例子是斯泰西·艾布拉姆斯，她曾是2018年民主党的州长候选人提名人。

sentences.en: I applied for my absentee ballot in May when there were some delay in receiving it.
sentences.zh: 我在5月份申请了我的缺席选票，当时收到选票有一些延迟。

sentences.en: But when it finally arrived, I received a ballot.
sentences.zh: 但当它终于到达时，我收到了一张选票。

sentences.en: I pulled out the ballot, completed it, and got ready to put it in the return envelope.
sentences.zh: 我拉出选票，填好，准备把它放进回邮信封里。

sentences.en: And the return envelope was sealed shut.
sentences.zh: 结果回邮信封被封死了。

sentences.en: And she talked about using an iron to try to unseal it.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了试图用熨斗把它解封。

sentences.en: And I attempted to steam it open because I've watched lots of mystery shows.
sentences.zh: 我试图用蒸汽把它熏开，因为我看过很多悬疑剧。

sentences.en: It did not work.
sentences.zh: 没有用。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 但没有成功。

sentences.en: And so she went and stood in line at an early voting site that Georgia had kept open for people to vote and was able to cast her ballot.
sentences.zh: 于是她去佐治亚州为人们投票而保持开放的早期投票点排队，并成功投了票。

sentences.en: Luckily for me, I live in an area where the lines were not terribly long.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我住的地方队伍并不是非常长。

sentences.en: But all I can think about are the people who did not receive their ballots, who were forced instead into hours-long lines.
sentences.zh: 但我能想到的只有那些没有收到选票、被迫在长达数小时的队伍中等待的人。

sentences.en: John Ossoff, who is the Democratic nominee for Senate from Georgia.
sentences.zh: 乔·奥索夫，佐治亚州民主党的参议员提名人。

sentences.en: My wife, Alicia, and I applied for our absentee ballots a month ago.
sentences.zh: 我和我的妻子艾丽西亚在一个月前申请了我们的缺席选票。

sentences.en: We wrote to the county.
sentences.zh: 我们写信给县里。

sentences.en: We sent letters to the county.
sentences.zh: 我们给县里发了信。

sentences.en: We sounded the alarm publicly.
sentences.zh: 我们在公开场合敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: We never got our ballots.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有拿到选票。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: I'm on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 我是候选人。

sentences.en: Waited five hours in line at a community swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 在一个社区游泳池排了五个小时的队。

sentences.en: And we waited five hours to do so.
sentences.zh: 我们为此排了五个小时的队。

sentences.en: Because he never received his absentee ballot.
sentences.zh: 因为他从来没有收到他的缺席选票。

sentences.en: And we are strong.
sentences.zh: 我们很强壮。

sentences.en: So we can do that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But think of the seniors.
sentences.zh: 但想想老年人吧。

sentences.en: And so after he waits in line for five hours and votes, he gets home.
sentences.zh: 因此，在他排了五个小时队并投完票后，他回到了家。

sentences.en: And what's come in the mail after a month is his absentee ballot.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，信箱里寄来的是他的缺席选票。

sentences.en: And then once Election Day came in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 然后佐治亚州的选举日到了。

sentences.en: Now to the primary day chaos.
sentences.zh: 现在到了初选日的混乱局面。

sentences.en: Hundreds of voters waiting in hours-long lines.
sentences.zh: 数百名选民在长达数小时的队伍中等待。

sentences.en: You had limits of how many people could be inside those rooms at churches and schools because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 由于疫情原因，你对教堂和学校房间内的人数有限制。

sentences.en: Voters told us they waited for as long as four hours to get inside to vote.
sentences.zh: 选民告诉我们，他们等了长达四个小时才得以进入内部投票。

sentences.en: So you had images of people waiting five, six hours in line outside the buildings in the summer Georgia heat.
sentences.zh: 所以你会看到这样的画面：人们在佐治亚州夏日的酷暑中，在大楼外的队伍中等待了五、六个小时。

sentences.en: We saw two voters turn around and drive off because the line was so long.
sentences.zh: 我们看到两名选民掉头开车离开，因为队伍太长了。

sentences.en: And not indoors waiting to vote inside.
sentences.zh: 而不是在室内排队等待投票。

sentences.en: Once I got inside, I think the most frustrating part was that several of the machines were broken.
sentences.zh: 一旦我进去了，我想最令人沮丧的部分是好几台机器都坏了。

sentences.en: It seemed like maybe half of the machines were down.
sentences.zh: 看起来差不多有一半的机器都瘫痪了。

sentences.en: Equipment was delivered late.
sentences.zh: 设备运送迟到了。

sentences.en: Some of it's not charged up.
sentences.zh: 有些甚至没有充电。

sentences.en: The check-in folks aren't really clear about what to do.
sentences.zh: 签到人员真的不太清楚该做些什么。

sentences.en: Waited, why do you think things went so badly in Georgia, both the mail-in and the in-person voting?
sentences.zh: 等等，你认为为什么佐治亚州的情况会变得如此糟糕，无论是邮寄投票还是现场投票？

sentences.en: The bottom line really is that it's really hard to run either a mail election or an in-person election.
sentences.zh: 最底线的原因其实是，无论是组织邮寄选举还是现场选举都非常困难。

sentences.en: And doing them both at the same time without really the resources to do either is a recipe for disaster.
sentences.zh: 而且在没有真正具备进行其中任何一项的资源的情况下，同时开展这两项选举简直就是灾难的配方。

sentences.en: The elections administrator for Fulton County, which includes Atlanta in Georgia, the night of the primary, said during a Zoom press conference.
sentences.zh: 富尔顿县（其中包含佐治亚州的亚特兰大）的选举管理员在初选当晚的一次 Zoom 新闻发布会上说。

sentences.en: The absentee by mail process, it was an election in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 邮寄缺席投票的流程本身就是一场选举。

sentences.en: That he was asked to run two elections at once.
sentences.zh: 他被要求同时举行两场选举。

sentences.en: We became an absentee by mail state.
sentences.zh: 我们变成了一个邮寄缺席投票的州。

sentences.en: We still had to do our full complement of election day infrastructure, and it stretched us.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然不得不开展我们全套的选举日基础设施，这让我们不堪重负。

sentences.en: And that he didn't have the resources or the capacity to do that.
sentences.zh: 他既没有资源也没有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: And that was precisely what led to all of the problems that people experienced on their primary day.
sentences.zh: 而这正是导致人们在初选日经历所有问题的原因所在。

sentences.en: We ran into a lot of challenges this time.
sentences.zh: 我们这次遇到了很多挑战。

sentences.en: So I think we are going to learn from this and move forward.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们将从中吸取教训并继续前进。

sentences.en: So Georgia seems almost like a case study of how not to hold an election in the middle of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以佐治亚州看起来几乎就像是在大流行期间如何不举行选举的案例研究。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, they kind of did all elements of what you would think of an election plus the mail-in voting, but didn't really do any of them well and didn't really devote
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他们基本上做了你对一场选举所能想到的所有环节，再加上邮寄投票，但没有一个环节做好，也没有真正把

sentences.en: adequate resources to any part of it.
sentences.zh: 足够的资源投入到任何一个部分。

sentences.en: And in the end, the result was about as bad an experience as you can get.
sentences.zh: 最后，结果就是你能遇到的最糟糕的体验。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App 时，你在 App 里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》App，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Reid, did any state get a pandemic primary right over the past couple of weeks and months?
sentences.zh: 里德，在过去几周和几个月里，有没有哪个州把大流行初选搞对了？

sentences.en: Were there any anti-Georgias?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么“反佐治亚州”的例子？

sentences.en: I mean, the best example is probably Montana.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，最好的例子可能是蒙大拿州。

sentences.en: The governor there, Steve Bullock, by executive order, gave the state's 56 counties the authority to mail ballots to all of their registered voters.
sentences.zh: 那里的州长史蒂夫·布洛克通过行政命令，赋予该州56个县将选票寄给所有已登记选民的权力。

sentences.en: And every registered voter in the state got a ballot in the mail.
sentences.zh: 州里的每一位登记选民都在邮件中收到了一张选票。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, they got a ballot, not a ballot application.
sentences.zh: 为了明确一下，他们收到的是选票，而不是选票申请表。

sentences.en: They got a ballot and not the application.
sentences.zh: 他们收到的是选票，而不是申请表。

sentences.en: So they skipped the step that Georgia and other states required.
sentences.zh: 所以他们跳过了佐治亚州和其他州所要求的步骤。

sentences.en: And so voters there got the ballots in the mail.
sentences.zh: 因此那里的选民在邮件中收到了选票。

sentences.en: They filled them out.
sentences.zh: 他们填好了选票。

sentences.en: And as long as they were returned before the deadline, the ballots counted.
sentences.zh: 只要在截止日期前寄回，选票就有效。

sentences.en: And in the end, Montana had the highest voter turnout of any state in this year's presidential primary.
sentences.zh: 最后，蒙大拿州创下了今年总统初选中所有州最高的选民投票率。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what happened with in-person voting in Montana?
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州的现场投票情况怎么样了？

sentences.en: They kept some of it, but not in a form that would be really recognizable in a pre-pandemic world.
sentences.zh: 他们保留了一部分，但形式已经和疫情前大不相同了。

sentences.en: There were boards of elections offices that were open for people who needed to change their registration or cast a ballot.
sentences.zh: 有些选举办公室对外开放，方便需要更改选民登记或投票的民众。

sentences.en: But for the vast majority of voters in Montana, the election took place through the mail.
sentences.zh: 但对蒙大拿州的绝大多数选民来说，选举是通过邮寄方式进行的。

sentences.en: Reid, I'm mindful that as smooth as this all seemed to go in Montana,
sentences.zh: 里德，我注意到蒙大拿州的这一切看起来虽然很顺利，

sentences.en: Montana is not necessarily representative of the whole country, right?
sentences.zh: 但蒙大拿州并不能完全代表整个国家，对吧？

sentences.en: It has a pretty small population.
sentences.zh: 它的人口相当少。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's about the same amount of people in the state of Montana as there are in Fulton County in Georgia, in the state's biggest county.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州的人口总量大约和佐治亚州最大的县——富尔顿县的人口差不多。

sentences.en: And so it is a much more challenging situation to run an election with a lot more people than it is in a small state.
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个人口众多的大州组织选举，要比在小州面临的情况挑战大得多。

sentences.en: So how useful is Montana as a model?
sentences.zh: 那么，蒙大拿州作为模范能有多大参考价值呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what Montana shows is that if you give people ballots and don't make them jump through hoops to get to them, you're more likely to have more of them return them and vote.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，蒙大拿州的经验表明，如果你把选票发给选民，不设置层层门槛，他们就更有可能把选票寄回来并完成投票。

sentences.en: Meaning just mailing them the actual ballots and not making them apply and then get the ballots the way Georgia did.
sentences.zh: 也就是直接把真正的选票寄给他们，而不需要像佐治亚州那样先申请再领票。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So kind of in summary, mail-in voting is complicated, especially complicated in big states, but it can
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，邮寄投票很复杂，在大州尤其复杂，但只要

sentences.en: work when local authorities get ballots into people's hands.
sentences.zh: 地方当局能把选票送到选民手中，它就能发挥作用。

sentences.en: In other words, this can work under ideal circumstances around the country.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，在全国的理想情况下，这行得通。

sentences.en: It can work when there's a concerted effort by local elections officials to make it work.
sentences.zh: 当地方选举官员齐心协力让它运作时，它就行得通。

sentences.en: If we went to mail-in balloting, our election all over the world would look as a total joke.
sentences.zh: 如果我们改用邮寄投票，我们在全世界的选举就会变成一个彻头彻尾的笑话。

sentences.en: It would be a total joke.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个彻头彻尾的笑话。

sentences.en: What's going on in this country now is you have the president who is making a concerted effort to make it not work.
sentences.zh: 现在这个国家发生的事情是，总统正在竭尽全力让它无法运作。

sentences.en: And they're in all the mailboxes.
sentences.zh: 选票都在邮箱里。

sentences.en: And kids go and they raid the mailboxes and they hand them to people that are signing the ballots down the end of the street, which is happening.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跑去洗劫邮箱，然后把选票交到街头尽头正在代签选票的人手里，这种事正在发生。

sentences.en: They grab the ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们抢夺选票。

sentences.en: You don't think that happens?
sentences.zh: 你认为这不会发生吗？

sentences.en: He regularly tweets and speaks about how mail voting is sort of fraud-filled and a recipe for disaster and a reason Republicans won't win.
sentences.zh: 他经常发推文并公开宣称邮寄投票充满了欺诈、是灾难的温床，也是共和党人无法获胜的原因。

sentences.en: In some cases, they won't sell them to a Republican community, a conservative community.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们不会把选票发给共和党社区、保守派社区。

sentences.en: They don't happen to send the ballots to those communities.
sentences.zh: 他们碰巧不把选票寄给那些社区。

sentences.en: And there's no way of checking.
sentences.zh: 而且根本没法核查。

sentences.en: No, you have to go and you have to vote.
sentences.zh: 不，你必须亲自去投票。

sentences.en: And so it hasn't taken long for this idea to take hold among Republican voters, particularly base Republican voters, that there is something inherently wrong with voting by mail.
sentences.zh: 因此，共和党选民、尤其是核心共和党选民很快就接受了这样一种观念，即邮寄投票本身存在某种问题。

sentences.en: And is there any documented evidence of that, that mail-in voting is somehow more open to fraud?
sentences.zh: 那有没有任何有据可查的证据表明，邮寄投票在某种程度上更容易滋生欺诈？

sentences.en: No, there's not.
sentences.zh: 不，并没有。

sentences.en: There have been a couple of isolated instances of what's called ballot harvesting.
sentences.zh: 只有过几次零星的被称为“选票收割”的案例。

sentences.en: We saw it in a congressional race in North Carolina a couple years ago from the
sentences.zh: 几年前我们在北卡罗来纳州的一次国会选举中看到了这一点，来自

sentences.en: Republican side.
sentences.zh: 共和党阵营。

sentences.en: But most of what you hear when people describe fraud in the vote-by-mail system are either old wives' tales or fantastic stories of an apartment building with 30 ballots in the
sentences.zh: 但当你听到人们描述邮寄投票系统中的欺诈时，大部分内容要么是老掉牙的谣言，要么是离奇的故事，比如某栋公寓楼的

sentences.en: mailbox.
sentences.zh: 邮箱里塞了30张选票。

sentences.en: Things that have been chain letters or Facebook memes that aren't necessarily grounded in any real evidence.
sentences.zh: 那些连环信或脸书迷因传播的内容，未必有什么真正的证据支撑。

sentences.en: So how do you explain why the president is claiming that this is a problematic mode of voting?
sentences.zh: 那你如何解释为什么总统声称这是一种有问题的投票方式呢？

sentences.en: What accounts for that?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致了这种说法？

sentences.en: I mean, there is a widespread belief among Republican voters and some Republican elected officials
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，共和党选民和一些共和党民选官员普遍有一种信念，

sentences.en: that allowing more people to vote will be advantageous to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 即允许更多人投票将对民主党有利。

sentences.en: And so taken in that context, it makes sense that he would resist some of the push toward mail-in voting because it does make it easier for a lot more people to vote.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种背景下，他抵制推行邮寄投票的做法就说得通了，因为这确实让更多人投票变得更容易。

sentences.en: Is there a version of this where the president seems to be discouraging mail-in voting, but mail-in voting becomes the predominant way that voting occurs in this fall's election?
sentences.zh: 有没有这样一种可能：总统表面上在极力反对邮寄投票，但邮寄投票最终却成为了今年秋季选举中的主要投票方式？

sentences.en: And therefore, wouldn't that mean that the president was telling his own voters, don't trust the most important way of voting for my re-election, for his re-election?
sentences.zh: 那么，这难道不意味着总统在告诉他自己的选民，不要信任对他连任、对他竞选连任最重要的投票方式吗？

sentences.en: And there's a lot of concern about that happening already.
sentences.zh: 很多人已经对这种情况的发生感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: You know, you see in states that aren't entirely vote-by-mail, but where it's a predominant way of voting, like Florida and Arizona, that have
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那些并非全州都是邮寄投票、但邮寄投票占主导地位的州（比如佛罗里达州和亚利桑那州），它们拥有

sentences.en: large populations of older Republican voters, that Republican officials in those states have been
sentences.zh: 大量的老年共和党选民，这些州的共和党官员一直

sentences.en: trying to push a message that's expressly counter to what the president has been saying about voting
sentences.zh: 在极力传达一种与总统关于邮寄投票的言论截然相反的信息；我们在犹他州也看到了这一点，那里的共和党州主席告诉我，他们的

sentences.en: by mail, that we've seen in Utah, where the Republican state chairman told me that their
sentences.zh: 系统与其他州不同，特朗普总统在描述其他地方的欺诈时，一定是在谈论犹他州以外的其他地方。

sentences.en: system is not like what happens in other states, and that President Trump, in describing fraud elsewhere, must be talking about somewhere else other than Utah.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在描述其他地方的欺诈时，一定是在谈论犹他州以外的其他地方。

sentences.en: So in other words, these officials are trying to tell their voters, trust the system, even if the president doesn't tell you to trust it?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这些官员正试图告诉他们的选民：即使总统叫你不要信任，你也要信任这个系统？

sentences.en: Trust the system here, because the system where you live, it's functional, and the president is talking about other places.
sentences.zh: 要信任这里的系统，因为你生活的地方的系统是正常运转的，总统说的其实是别的地方。

sentences.en: But that sort of nuance is lost on a lot of voters who, you know, hear what the president says and are generally disinclined to believe people who disagree with him, particularly
sentences.zh: 但这种细微差别被许多选民忽略了，你知道，他们听信了总统的话，普遍不愿意相信那些意见与他相左的人，特别是

sentences.en: within their own party, because of the way that the party and the president have functioned over the last four years.
sentences.zh: 在他们自己的党内，因为过去四年里党内和总统的运作方式就是如此。

sentences.en: So couldn't the president be actually hurting his own re-election chances by doing this?
sentences.zh: 那么，总统这样做难道不会损害他自己的连任几率吗？

sentences.en: He's certainly hurting the enthusiasm for voting by mail among his Republican supporters.
sentences.zh: 他当然在损害他的共和党支持者对邮寄投票的热情。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Reed, back to this three months to the day that we will have the presidential election, where would you say the whole country is?
sentences.zh: 那么里德，回到距离我们举行总统大选还有整整三个月这个话题上，你觉得整个国家目前处于什么状态？

sentences.en: Are most states looking like Georgia?
sentences.zh: 大多数州看起来都像佐治亚州吗？

sentences.en: You know, this is going to be a mess?
sentences.zh: 你知道，情况会一团糟吗？

sentences.en: Or are a lot of states looking like Montana in terms of their preparations for this election, which is to say they can pull it off?
sentences.zh: 还是说，很多州在为这场选举的筹备工作上看起来像蒙那大州，也就是说他们能够顺利搞定？

sentences.en: I think we have more states that at the moment are looking like Georgia than Montana.
sentences.zh: 我认为目前看起来更像佐治亚州的州要比像蒙大拿州的州多。

sentences.en: Of the 45 states that have some sort of in-person voting, almost all of them are going to open polling places for people to show up at.
sentences.zh: 在45个实行某种形式的现场投票的州中，几乎所有州都将开放投票站供民众前往。

sentences.en: But as we've seen it, it's really hard to do two elections at once.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所看到的，同时进行两场选举真的很难。

sentences.en: And it's complex.
sentences.zh: 而且它很复杂。

sentences.en: It involves a lot of resources.
sentences.zh: 这需要大量的资源。

sentences.en: And most of these states haven't done a big general election where most of their voters cast ballots in the mail.
sentences.zh: 并且这些州大多没有经历过绝大多数选民通过邮寄方式投票的大型大选。

sentences.en: It's going to be new for the voters.
sentences.zh: 这对选民来说将是全新的体验。

sentences.en: It's going to be new for the elections administrators.
sentences.zh: 对选举管理人员来说也是全新的。

sentences.en: And it's going to be new for the people that count the ballots on election night.
sentences.zh: 对于在选举之夜清点选票的人来说也将是全新的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Reid, what are the likely consequences of so many states trying this for the first time?
sentences.zh: 那么里德，这么多州首次尝试这样做，可能会产生什么后果？

sentences.en: I mean, the first obvious consequence is on November 3rd in the evening when we're used to turning on television and the internet and seeing the results of the elections come in,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，最显而易见的后果就是，在11月3日的晚上，当我们习惯于打开电视和互联网等待选举结果出炉时，

sentences.en: we may not have them.
sentences.zh: 我们可能拿不到结果。

sentences.en: And what President Trump and Joe Biden do about declaring victory or not,
sentences.zh: 至于特朗普总统和乔·拜登将如何宣布获胜与否，

sentences.en: Trump has said the election should be called on election night no matter what.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾表示，无论如何都应该在选举之夜宣布选举结果。

sentences.en: But we know that there will be millions and millions of ballots that aren't counted on election night,
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，在选举之夜将有数百万张选票无法被统计，

sentences.en: whether it's because states have voting rules that say your ballot counts as long as it's postmarked
sentences.zh: 无论是由于各州的投票规则规定，只要选票在选举日之前加盖邮戳就有效，

sentences.en: by election day, or because it takes some of these states longer to count an absentee ballot that
sentences.zh: 还是因为这些州清点通过邮件寄达的缺席选票所需的时间，要比清点在投票站标记并投入机器的选票所需的时间更长。

sentences.en: came in the mail than it would have taken them to count a ballot that was marked and delivered into a machine at a polling place.
sentences.zh: 这比清点在投票站里填好并投入机器的选票要花更多时间。

sentences.en: And all of that is going to have a real significant impact on what we know about the presidential contest, the Senate races, and races all down the ballot.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都将对我们了解总统竞选、参议院竞选以及所有其他级别的竞选结果产生重大影响。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And of course, that's just when we know the results.
sentences.zh: 当然，这还只是我们何时能知道结果的问题。

sentences.en: If this election is as messy and complicated as everything you're saying suggests it might be, I wonder if that raises a much bigger
sentences.zh: 如果这次选举像你所说的那样混乱和复杂，我在想，这是否会引发一个更重大

sentences.en: question, which is how much do you think the country will trust the outcome of the elections on November 3rd if voting ends up feeling kind of haphazard?
sentences.zh: 的问题，那就是如果投票最终让人感觉有点随心所欲，你认为国民会对11月3日的选举结果信任多少？

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of that will depend on people's experiences heading into the election, whether
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很大程度上取决于人们在选举前的亲身经历，比如

sentences.en: a lot of people have problems voting by mail or don't even try to vote by mail or have to wait in line for hours at either early voting centers or on election day.
sentences.zh: 很多人在邮寄投票时遇到问题，或者根本不敢尝试邮寄投票，又或者不得不在提前投票中心或选举日的队伍中等上几个小时。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of the feelings about this was going to be dictated, frankly, by what the president says and does.
sentences.zh: 你知道，坦白说，人们对这一情况的许多感受将由总统的言行来决定。

sentences.en: You know, if the president wakes up on the morning of November 4th and says, I don't care that there are more votes left to be counted.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果总统在11月4日清晨醒来并说道：我才不管还有多少选票没数完呢。

sentences.en: I won.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。

sentences.en: Then you can sort of imagine how that's going to play out.
sentences.zh: 那么你大概可以想象事情会如何发展了。

sentences.en: Or if there's a state like take Arizona, where it appears that President Trump has won on election night, but four
sentences.zh: 或者如果出现这样一个州——比如亚利桑那州，特朗普总统在选举之夜似乎赢了，但四

sentences.en: days later, they've received more votes and it flips to Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 天后，他们收到了更多的选票，结果翻盘转向了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: And that's the deciding state.
sentences.zh: 而这又是决定胜负的关键州。

sentences.en: There's innumerable chaos that could happen from that.
sentences.zh: 由此可能会引发数不清的混乱。

sentences.en: And so it doesn't take much to make this system look like it's chaotic, even though in a lot of times it's either sort of how the system is designed to
sentences.zh: 因此，要让这个系统看起来一团糟并不难，尽管在很多时候，这本来就是该系统设计之中的运作方式，

sentences.en: work because mail-in voting just does take longer.
sentences.zh: 因为邮寄投票确实需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: Even though it's a more efficient way of getting more people to vote, it can take longer to tabulate the results from that.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一种让更多人投票的更有效方式，但汇总其中的结果确实需要更长时间。

sentences.en: So you're basically telling us to be patient and Americans are not patient.
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上是在告诉我们要有耐心，而美国人并没有耐心。

sentences.en: They're not.
sentences.zh: 他们确实没有。

sentences.en: No, I mean, if you want to not stress out about the results of the election, buy a plane ticket to someplace without internet access or cell signal on November 2nd and come
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，如果你不想为选举结果感到焦虑，那就买张11月2日飞往没有互联网接入或手机信号的地方的机票，然后

sentences.en: back a week and a half later.
sentences.zh: 一个半星期后再回来。

sentences.en: Or three weeks or four weeks.
sentences.zh: 或者三周、四周后。

sentences.en: Go to the Galapagos Islands or somewhere and come back in a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 去加拉帕戈斯群岛或某个地方，过两周再回来。

sentences.en: And by then you might, you'll probably know who won.
sentences.zh: 到那时你可能、大概就知道谁赢了。

sentences.en: Well, Reed, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，里德，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Democratic governor of Nevada, Steve Sisolak, signed a law that would require sending ballots to every registered voter in the state, saying that it would ensure,
sentences.zh: 周一，内华达州民主党籍州长史蒂夫·西索拉克签署了一项法律，要求向该州每一位登记选民寄送选票，并称这将确保

sentences.en: quote, the safest, most accessible election possible under these unprecedented circumstances.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话说，“在这些前所未有的情况下，实现尽可能最安全、最便利的选举。”

sentences.en: In response, President Trump threatened legal action to try to block the measure.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，特朗普总统威胁将采取法律行动以阻止该措施。

sentences.en: Well, there's never been a push like this for mail-in ballots.
sentences.zh: 嗯，过去从未有过这样大力推动邮寄选票的做法。

sentences.en: And if you look at...
sentences.zh: 如果你看看……

sentences.en: During a news conference at the White House, Trump was asked whether he would consider restricting mail-in voting nationwide through an executive order.
sentences.zh: 在白宫举行的一场新闻发布会上，当被问及是否会考虑通过行政命令在全国范围内限制邮寄投票时，特朗普做出了回应。

sentences.en: Universal mail-in ballots is going to be a great embarrassment to our country.
sentences.zh: 全民邮寄选票将是我们国家的巨大耻辱。

sentences.en: Well, I have the right to do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有权这么做。

sentences.en: We haven't gotten there yet, but we'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们还没走到那一步，但我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: We will be suing in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 我们将在内华达州提起诉讼。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Manhattan District Attorney, Cy Vance, suggested that his investigation into
sentences.zh: 周一，曼哈顿地区检察官赛·万斯暗示，他对

sentences.en: President Trump's finances and company is much broader than previously known.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的财务状况及其公司的调查范围比此前所知的要广泛得多。

sentences.en: A new court filing indicates that the investigation, which was thought to focus on hush money payments
sentences.zh: 一份新的法院文件表明，这项原本被认为聚焦于2016年竞选期间

sentences.en: made to women during the 2016 campaign, may actually be examining a range of possible criminal activity, including potential bank and insurance fraud.
sentences.zh: 向女性支付的封口费的调查，实际上可能正在审查一系列可能的犯罪活动，包括潜在的银行欺诈和保险欺诈。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court sided with Vance in a major ruling last month, saying that the president
sentences.zh: 最高法院在上个月的一项重大裁决中站在了万斯一边，称总统

sentences.en: lacked the legal basis to block the district attorney from seeking years of his tax records as part of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 缺乏法律依据来阻止地区检察官在调查中索取其多年的纳税记录。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that nearly 3,000 small businesses in New York City have permanently closed because of the pandemic, more than in any U.S.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，纽约市已有近3000家小企业因疫情永久关店，这一数字超过了美国任何一个

sentences.en: city.
sentences.zh: 城市。

sentences.en: A new report estimates that one-third of the city's small businesses, or about 75,000 of them, may never reopen because of lockdowns and lost revenue.
sentences.zh: 一份新的报告估计，由于封锁和营收损失，该市三分之一的小企业、即大约75000家小企业可能永远不会重新开业。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们准备节日待客之道。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家一样舒适的秘诀。
